question: In which event at the 2023 ISSF Junior World Cup Championships did Amanpreet Singh win a gold medal for India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Men's 25 m pistol**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amanpreet Singh** won the gold medal in the **Men's 25 m pistol** event at the 2023 ISSF Junior World Cup Championships.
 
• The ISSF Junior World Cup is a prestigious event where young shooters from around the world compete in various shooting disciplines.
 
• Amanpreet Singh's victory adds to India's growing reputation in the international shooting arena.
 
• This achievement is significant as it showcases the talent and potential of Indian shooters at the junior level.
 
• The win is expected to inspire and motivate other young shooters in India to excel in the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF)** organizes the Junior World Cup to provide a platform for young shooting talent.
 
• India has been consistently performing well in shooting sports, with several young athletes making their mark at international events.
 
• The Indian government and various sports organizations have been supporting shooting sports through training programs and infrastructure development.
 
• Such international victories are crucial for the development of the sport and the athletes involved.
 
• Amanpreet Singh's success is a testament to the hard work and dedication of the athletes and their coaches.
